thread:
Jenna (PM): heads up — enterprise customer asks for a consumption-credits option layered on top of existing tiers. wants ability to buy a monthly seat + burst credits that auto-top up when they cross thresholds. asking if this is feasible for H1 launch.
Alex C: technically doable but needs clear guardrails. main risk is quota enforcement and rate limiting interaction with Dedicated pools.
Marta R: +1 to having an interim 'credits' addon rather than a full new tier. easier to ship and market.
Praveen S: customers asking for predictable overage handling — they prefer credits instead of surprise invoices. also call out contractual limits: some customers need a hard ceiling in the contract.
Dan S: negotiation note: if we offer auto-top-up, we need an opt-out flow so finance teams can block spend.
pricing-bot: current data: median monthly overage across pilot accounts = 18% of committed; 90th pct = 62%. estimated net revenue impact of credits addon (conservative) = +3% ARR for pilot cohort.
Alex C: implementation sketch: 1) add credits balance on account record; 2) consumption costs drawn from balance first; 3) billing event emits when balance < threshold. Need schema change + idempotent top-up endpoint.
Alex C: quota interplay: when credits used up, do we soft-fail, throttle, or fallback to base slab? We need policy.
Marta R: proposal: policy = (a) if contract has hard ceiling -> deny calls once credits exhausted; (b) otherwise soft-fail with clear response + email to admin and optional auto-top-up.
Praveen S: legal asks that auto-top-ups are explicit in MSA. add consent checkbox in UI and record audit trail.
Jenna (PM): launch criteria draft: docs, billing pipeline support, explicit consent UI, admin email alerts, handbook for sales + legal signoff, 2 pilot customers onboarded, e2e tests for balance/top-up.
Dan S: add requirement: pricing matrix must show both per-token rate with credits and equivalent per-token without credits so procurement can compare.
Marta R: rollout plan: alpha -> internal test orgs (2 weeks) -> 2 paid pilot customers (4 weeks) -> general availability. Toggle behind runtime feature-flag and billing-flag.
Alex C: ops notes: add metrics: credits_consumed_by_tier, topups_count, declined_due_to_ceiling. add alert if topups spike > 3x baseline.
Praveen S: sales asks: include clause for manual invoice top-ups for large customers, and override flow for immediate emergency credits.
Jenna (PM): UX callout: admin console needs a one-click refund and a CSV export of top-ups for audit.
Marta R: minimum viable API: `POST /accounts/:id/topup {amount, source}` and webhook `account.credits.updated`. keep payload minimal.
Alex C: quick config example we can reuse in config repo:
```
credits:
  enabled: true
  auto_topup_threshold_pct: 10
  default_topup_amount: 100000
```
Marta R: pricing implication: decide whether credits discount the token price or just prepay same units. recommend same units (no discount) at launch to simplify billing.
Dan S: negotiation tip: offer a limited-time bonus credits for signups to encourage pilots. track conversion.
Praveen S: risk: audit/compliance for regulated customers — need KYC on payment methods for auto-topups. legal may block for some geos.
Jenna (PM): decision points for next week: (1) credit semantics (prepay units vs discount) (2) contract ceiling behavior (deny vs soft-fail) (3) UI consent wording (must include billing contact) (4) pilot customers list. please react or add blockers. :eyes:
Alex C: blocker — need ETA from billing team on supporting `credits` as a first-class ledger item.
pricing-bot: billing-team-status: ticket #BILL-482 opened, initial estimate 3 weeks for ledger work (T-0).
Marta R: I'll scope a short spec and mockups by EOD Thursday.
Praveen S: I'll confirm two pilot customers (one SMB, one enterprise) by Friday.
Dan S: ok to proceed with alpha gate once billing team confirms API contract. :thumbsup:
Jenna (PM): thanks — will consolidate decision doc and schedule scoping sync for Monday.
